title: [Bug] Run at startup toggle silently reverts when PowerToys is not elevated (task save fails with 0x80070005)

inferences: Task/folder ownership or permission state may distinguish normal and elevated attempts; that condition has not been measured on the reporter machine.
initial_investigation: Read the full report, supplied archive and exact-reported-release task registration/caller code, then checked the same current-main call pattern.
Separated the benign missing-folder probe from the later registration access denial. No generic logs are requested because the supplied archive already demonstrates the failure.
This is a lightweight proposed investigation/fix direction, not an implementation-grade approved design or executed runtime reproduction.

Re-read the current complete report and empty discussion: the normal/elevated contrast, supplied archive and task-save HRESULT are still present. No new reporter answer identifies the underlying ACL condition.

Checked current general_settings.cpp at upstream 7557026e: all four create_auto_start_task_for_this_user calls still ignore the boolean result. The prior exact-release archive/source evidence remains historical; no new runtime, ACL change or archive execution is claimed.
issue_context.summary: Supplied diagnostics confirm startup task-save access denial; unchecked registration result warrants a focused failure-feedback investigation.
known_information: The report gives an explicit non-elevated reproduction and an elevated contrast on0.102.3001, with Run at startup reverting and no surviving registration.
The supplied archive was downloaded and its complete November2runner log inspected: five Error saving the Task entries with HRESULT0x80070005 and one missing-folder0x80070002 entry.

Exact v0.102.3001 auto_start_helper.cpp returns false when RegisterTaskDefinition fails. In general_settings.cpp the startup branches ignore the boolean result of create_auto_start_task_for_this_user.
Current main retains the unchecked registration call pattern. No ACL, user token or system Task Scheduler state was modified or independently reproduced.
issue_context.analysis: The missing-folder probe is not itself proof of the registration cause, but repeated task-save access denial is real. Surface the failed operation instead of allowing an apparently accepted toggle to revert without explanation. First reproduce the permission/elevation matrix; do not broaden task permissions or make permanent elevation the default.

fix_assessment.rationale: There is a specific observed failure and a verified unchecked result path; a focused proposal is warranted, but the underlying ACL cause and best UI/elevation contract remain to be established.

prerequisites: Windows test account with administrator membership, initially non-elevated PowerToys.
Disposable test environment; retain existing task state before any test-owned changes.
steps: With Always run as administrator off, enable Run at startup, reopen Settings and inspect the actual per-user task state and runner HRESULT.
Repeat from an elevated process under the same account.
Repeat in a controlled environment with fresh versus pre-existing task folder/task ownership to isolate the access-denied precondition.
reproduce.expected: Successful registration keeps the toggle on; failed registration leaves it off and provides a clear localized error rather than silent reversion.

proposed_fixes.title: Propagate startup task-registration failure to Settings
plan: Reproduce fresh and pre-existing task-folder/task ownership with the same account non-elevated and elevated, retaining HRESULT and actual registration state.
Have the runner report the failed registration outcome through the existing Settings response path; keep startup=false when no active task exists.

Add localized, accessible feedback for access denied and other failures; decide separately whether a one-shot elevation action is appropriate. Do not weaken task ACLs or silently enable always-elevated execution.
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Verified feedback gap: startup task creation returns false after access denial, but apply_general_settings ignores that result. The exact permission/ownership condition causing the denial is still a hypothesis, not a proven universal administrator requirement.

confidence.rationale: Archive and exact-source call path support the feedback gap; controlled ACL reproduction and response/UI design are still needed before implementation.

verification: On0.102.3001 reproduce the provided normal/elevated contrast; verify the task exists only after a successful operation.
Exercise missing folder, inaccessible existing task, successful create and disabled-by-policy cases; failed attempts must produce clear feedback and truthful toggle state.
Regression-check successful non-elevated per-user startup and startup policy behavior; review task permissions without changing them globally.
